statement: The closest work's SFT stage is LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-14B for 8 epochs on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU with maximum sequence length 4096 tokens and effective batch size 32 (micro-batch 1, gradient accumulation 32), which is far cheaper than its RL stage (4xH200) and materially improves the feasibility of re-running the SFT-stage contrasts.
